overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds across the Montrose (High Elevation) area today, with dry mid-level fuels the main driver rather than any single extreme factor.**
- Week-ahead outlook stays Moderate through Sept. 25, as ERC drifts up from 55% to 64% while fuels slowly dry.
- Light 7–11 mph NE/ENE winds and a stray afternoon shower today keep fire behavior in check.
- 0 of 7 local watch-out thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is posted for the area.
- Montrose County lifted its Stage 1 fire restrictions for unincorporated areas effective September 16, 2026.
- Gunnison County is not currently under fire restrictions as of September 18, 2026.
- Nearby, the Elk Fire near Lake City (Hinsdale County) sits at 7,257 acres, 73% contained, with full containment estimated Oct. 31.
